question: After 1500 cycles, what capacity does the cathode deliver per gram of sulfur and per gram of the whole electrode, and what sulfur share of the electrode does their ratio imply, against the sulfur content the paper states?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE text ILIKE '%1500%' OR text ILIKE '%mAh%' OR text ILIKE '%wt%' OR text ILIKE '%loading%' OR text ILIKE '%sulfur content%' OR text ILIKE '%electrode%' ORDER BY page, id
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=5 AND line_no BETWEEN 95 AND 115 OR (page=5 AND id IN ('p5.L79','p5.L81','p5.L87')) ORDER BY page, line_no

WITH v AS (
SELECT CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p5.L105'), '([0-9]+) mAh/g', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS electrode,
       CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p5.L103'), '([0-9]+) mAh/', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS sulfur)
SELECT electrode, sulfur, electrode/sulfur AS ratio, 100*electrode/sulfur AS implied_sulfur_pct FROM v

WITH v AS (
SELECT CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p5.L105'), '([0-9]+) mAh/g', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS electrode,
       CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p5.L103'), '([0-9]+) mAh/', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS sulfur,
       CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM atoms WHERE id='p5.L108'), '([0-9]+) wt % active sulfur', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS stated)
SELECT 100*electrode/sulfur AS implied_pct, stated - 100*electrode/sulfur AS gap_points, stated FROM v

SELECT 100*CAST(regexp_extract(e.text, '([0-9]+) mAh/g', 1) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(regexp_extract(s.text, '([0-9]+) mAh/', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS implied_sulfur_pct, CAST(regexp_extract(t.text, '([0-9]+) wt % active sulfur', 1) AS DOUBLE) - 100*CAST(regexp_extract(e.text, '([0-9]+) mAh/g', 1) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(regexp_extract(s.text, '([0-9]+) mAh/', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS gap_points FROM atoms e, atoms s, atoms t WHERE e.id='p5.L105' AND s.id='p5.L103' AND t.id='p5.L108'

rendered: After 1500[1] cycles the cathode delivers 306 mAh/[2]gS delivered at cycle 1500[3], i.e. per gram of sulfur. Per gram of the whole electrode it delivers 87 mAh/g[4] after the same cycle count. The ratio of these values implies a sulfur share of the electrode of 28.4[5] percent, against the sulfur content the paper states: 35 wt % active sulfur[6]. The implied share is below the stated figure by 6.6[7] percentage points, so the figures do not agree exactly. The paper does not reconcile this gap.
